subject: Re: Request for processing proofs & cross-border assurance
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluecrest.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueCrest Security <security@bluecrest.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: proof of processing, transfers & subprocessor roster

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo today — BlueCrest's legal/security team asked me to collect a few items so we can finish our vendor review. Can you share the following by end of week?

1) Current list of subprocessors (hosting, logging, analytics, model infra) with locations and whether they process EU personal data.
2) Evidence of data-transfer safeguards for cross-border flows (standard contractual clauses, EU transfer mechanisms) and any current reliance on SCCs or adequacy determinations.
3) A short statement confirming Redwood's support for a DPIA-related questionnaire and any timelines for providing Art.28/30 records (processing activities register).
4) Latest SOC2 or equivalent summary and date of last audit.

If it's easier, a single shared ZIP or Drive folder with the items and a one-page cover note is fine. Also let me know if any of these require an NDA / controlled sharing.

Appreciate it — feel free to loop in whoever owns privacy at Redwood.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Contracts & Security Liaison
BlueCrest Analytics
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluecrest.ai>

Hi Priya — thanks for the list and the clear ask. Looping in Marissa (Privacy Operations) and Jonas (Legal ops) so we can collate everything and confirm sharing controls.

High-level plan:
- Marissa will prepare the subprocessor export with locations and EU processing flags and attach the SOC2 summary.
- I'll prepare a cover note that calls out transfer mechanisms (SCCs in place for relevant partners, reliance on EU adequacy for some cloud regions) and confirm estimated delivery.
- Jonas, can you advise whether we need a redline to our standard DPA or if a temporary NDA is required for additional evidence?

We should be able to deliver the folder and one-pager by EOD Thu (11/26). If BlueCrest needs signed SCCs or executed DPA amendments, that may take longer — we'll flag it.

Thanks,
Soogin Lee

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: proof of processing, transfers & subprocessor roster

Priya / Soojin — attaching the requested artifacts for initial review. See attached: Redwood_Security_Summary_2026.pdf (executive SOC2 summary), subprocessors_export_20261120.csv (current roster with country and EU-processing flag), and SOC2_TypeII_coverletter.pdf (auditor's cover letter).

Quick notes on the export:
- Column keys: service, vendor_name, vendor_role, primary_country, processes_eu_data (yes/no), purpose, contract_reference.
- We mark a subset of hosting and telemetry vendors as 'yes' under processes_eu_data; for those we have SCCs in place where the vendor is a data importer.
- For internal model-serving clusters in EU regions we do not rely on transfers — data stays in-region unless a customer explicitly opts into cross-region processing.

Regarding Art.28/30 / DPIA support: we maintain a processing activities register and can produce a scoped extract for your DPIA team. Standard turnaround: 2–3 business days for a CSV extract scoped to specific services (longer if you need itemized logs or raw audit records).

About SCCs & transfers:
- We accept the EU Commission's updated SCCs; executed copies are held centrally (we can provide signed copies for specific subprocessors on request).
- For major cloud providers we rely on their adequacy+SCC posture; we can surface more detail for any vendor you highlight.

If BlueCrest needs a tighter legal posture (e.g., specific contract language or a DPA addendum to include audit-rights beyond our standard DPA), please indicate the clause and we'll route to Legal.

Attachments referenced — if you want them uploaded to a controlled Drive folder (preferred) send the Drive email address OR we can issue a secure share link (expires in 14 days).

Thanks — sending the Drive link and the short cover note in a follow-up.

—Marissa Cole
Privacy Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluecrest.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: proof of processing, transfers & subprocessor roster

Thanks all — quick legal note:
- We can provide scoped evidence and signed SCCs for subprocessors. For audit-rights requests beyond standard DPA (e.g., on-site audits, continuous access to raw logs) we'll need to review and likely propose a remote, redacted evidence approach or a limited-scope on-site plan with an NDA and reasonable notice (30 days).
- If BlueCrest wants specific DPA redlines, please send a redline PDF/Doc and we'll respond with tracked comments.

Priya — next steps from our side: Marissa will upload the folder to a secure Drive and I'll prepare a short cover memo describing the transfer mechanisms and recommended path for signed SCCs or DPA amendments. Expect the Drive link + memo in the next message.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
